items.title: Jerry Hey interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 2, 2023
items.q: Dolly Parton’s “9 to 5” is like $110 every couple of years I guess sort of.

ctx.x: Do you get envelopes in the mail on occasion with payments for things that you didn’t expect?

Yeah. Not a lot, but every once in a while. Dolly Parton’s “9 to 5” is like $110 every couple of years I guess sort of. I played on “I Love L.A.” with Randy Newman on the session that we did on that record. The bridge part of it, if you know that [scats] I said, they said, “Well what do you think about on this song?” And I said, “What about like a mariachi kind of thing, you know ‘I Love L.A.’ a mariachi.” So I played that mariachi style, it kind of sounded like Herb Alpert in harmony parts you know. If they used…
something you know, like that. You know not a lot, but every once in a while something comes in.
